sessions.phase_label: Initial layout review and editorial refinement
Launch-critical fixes and final publication delivery

requirements.title: Website Article Sourcing
requirements.definition: Obtain the magazine articles directly from the WB Edition website rather than relying only on separately supplied article documents.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers acquisition of article content from the website; selection, inclusion, and placement of that content are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Required Issue Content Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include all client-specified articles, advertisements, special pages, and other issue assets in the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual articles, advertisements, and the tribute page are content items within one issue-completeness mechanism rather than separate reusable Requirements.

requirements.title: Issue Pagination and Editorial Order
requirements.definition: Arrange the issue's content into a coherent page sequence based on the current flat plan and client-directed placement decisions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers page order, article flow, and placement decisions; content completeness, table-of-contents accuracy, and cover references can fail or change independently.

requirements.title: Article Page Whitespace Balance
requirements.definition: Avoid conspicuous empty areas at article endings by balancing pages with relevant images or other client-approved editorial elements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently reviewed page-balance behavior, including requesting and placing supplemental visuals; image resolution and typography remain separate quality dimensions.

requirements.title: Accurate Table of Contents
requirements.definition: Produce a table of contents that reflects the finalized article order and correct page numbers.
requirements.boundary_note: Accuracy of contents entries is separate from optional interactive hyperlinks connecting contents and article pages.

requirements.title: Accurate Cover Article References
requirements.definition: Ensure cover-listed articles and their displayed page references agree with the finalized magazine content and pagination.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover-reference accuracy can be corrected independently of the table of contents and general pagination.

requirements.title: Article Author Attribution
requirements.definition: Show each article's author name with the correct, compact circular author photograph.
requirements.boundary_note: Author identity and photo treatment have their own correction trajectory and are independent of article category labeling.

requirements.title: Article Category Labels
requirements.definition: Display the applicable WB Edition category label on each article in a visually appropriate manner.
requirements.boundary_note: Category labeling has its own expected value and can be changed or omitted independently of author attribution.

requirements.title: Readable Article Body Typography
requirements.definition: Use a client-approved body typeface and weight that is legible, comfortable to read, and suitable for the modern magazine and flipbook presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Body-font selection has a distinct proposal, disagreement, sample, and client-acceptance trajectory, so it is separate from general branding and page balance.

requirements.title: Brand-Aligned Magazine Visual Style
requirements.definition: Apply a polished, modern, visually consistent layout that matches WB Edition branding and uses brand colors appropriately.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall visual system and brand-color treatment; body-font choice, author presentation, and asset resolution are independently reviewable Requirements.

requirements.title: Publication-Quality Image Assets
requirements.definition: Improve, replace, regenerate, or otherwise prepare low-quality supplied images when needed so they appear suitable in the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers resolution and visual preparation of general imagery; advertisement sizing, bleed, and safe-zone handling have a separate production trajectory.

requirements.title: Advertisement Quality and Safe Placement
requirements.definition: Prepare supplied advertisements so they render clearly, fit their assigned pages, and keep important content within appropriate trim and safe boundaries.
requirements.boundary_note: Advertisement rendering and safe placement can fail independently of general article-image quality and of whether every required advertisement is included.

requirements.title: Flipbook-Ready Digital PDF
requirements.definition: Deliver the final pages PDF in a form suitable for upload and balanced display as a digital flipbook, including correct page/spread behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers compatibility and delivery of the publication PDF; hosting-account ownership, platform branding, and document hyperlinks can change independently.

requirements.title: Flipbook Hosting and Platform Branding
requirements.definition: Use an acceptable flipbook hosting arrangement, initially free if possible, while resolving unwanted provider branding and upload ownership.
requirements.boundary_note: Platform selection, white-label branding, and responsibility for uploading are one hosting mechanism distinct from preparation of the PDF itself.

requirements.title: Interactive Contents Navigation
requirements.definition: Provide internal hyperlinks between the contents page and article or chapter pages, including return navigation to the contents.
requirements.boundary_note: Interactive navigation is independently implementable and testable even when the visible table-of-contents entries are already accurate.

requirements.title: Print-Ready Magazine PDF
requirements.definition: Provide a press-quality print version with production-appropriate resolution, trim, and bleed settings when that output remains in scope.
requirements.boundary_note: The print artifact has an explicit removal history and must remain separate from the required digital flipbook output.

requirements.title: Pre-August Digital Launch Deadline
requirements.definition: Complete and make the inaugural digital issue launchable within the client's time-sensitive pre-August release window.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a bounded launch constraint with its own deadline changes and defer/resume-like trajectory, not a generic project-status Requirement.

requirements.title: Editable Magazine Template and Source Files
requirements.definition: Create and hand over the reusable editable magazine template and associated source files so future issues can be produced from the established layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Template creation and editable-source handoff form one reusable-artifact obligation separate from delivery of flattened publication PDFs.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer proposed comprehensive punctuation and editorial-style normalization, but the supplied exchange does not clearly establish whether the client required full copy editing as an independent deliverable.
Several approvals refer to empty attachment messages whose visual contents are unavailable, so the specific Requirement verified by each approval cannot be identified safely.
